properties.evidence: skill_lint, the one CI gate over skill-to-surface agreement, checks only that a backticked name in a SKILL.md is a #[tool] method. A refusing stub counts as served, tool descriptions and refusal texts are never read, and no tool/parameter pairing is checked. So repair_report's description has named the stub record_change since the 2026-09-18 rename, and the gate is green today (measured).
